text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could you sign our petition?! 
It's a petition to extend the Horse Girl 
lane!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Extending the Horse Girl lane...? Which 
road are we talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
It's the Horse Girl lane on the main 
street, but it cuts off right after the 
curve.

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I almost ran into pedestrians several 
times myself... And there are plenty of 
others who've had the exact same scary 
experience!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Cars go pretty fast around there, too. 
...Have you tried bringing it up with the 
city?

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Of course we appealed! But they dismissed 
us, saying, 'Safety is already guaranteed 
with the curved mirror'!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're collecting signatures. 
Our only option left is to show just how 
many people are worried about 
accidents...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I get it. But an accident could happen 
while we're standing around doing this. 
...Then it'd be too late.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If the city office won't listen, how about 
talking directly to someone at the very 
top?!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if we just barge in out of 
nowhere, they probably won't listen to 
us... Besides, we don't even know who to 
talk to...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me! On my way here, I saw 
a city council member giving a speech...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, you two! We can't let a chance 
like this slip by!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right...! Let's give it all we've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On the way back from shopping, I happened 
to see a city council member giving a 
street speech.

text_block_list.name: City Council Member
text_block_list.text:
With a single-minded desire to develop 
this city, I will visit every corner to 
deliver my vision! Thank you very much for 
listening!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Excuuuse meee!! Do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Campaign Staff
text_block_list.text:
Who are you girls? If you want to talk, 
make an appointment first.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
An accident could happen before then...! 
It has to be right now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!! Extend the horse girl lane along the 
main street!

text_block_list.name: City Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Along the main street...? Is it truly that 
dangerous of a spot?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Someone should have already consulted 
the town about it once before. But it 
sounds like the talks never went 
anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The path suddenly cuts off right after a 
curve! Once you pick up speed you can't 
stop in time, so there's a serious risk of 
collisions!

text_block_list.name: City Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Understood. We'll look into whether 
this issue can be brought up on the agenda 
at the next council meeting.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Could you give us a promise instead of 
just looking into it?! Promise us you'll 
extend the path so we can run safely!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
! Everyone's safety in this town is on the 
line!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Us too...! That lane is seriously 
dangerous, I'm always terrified whenever I 
run through there!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
There's a convex mirror, but it's 
positioned too high for kids to see 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Here... We collected signatures too! Look 
at how many people think it's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This is the voice of this town—our voice! 
Please listen to us!! Come on!!

text_block_list.name: City Council Member
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. In that case, may I take 
those signatures and documents? We'll 
incorporate it into our road improvement 
plan and get to work on it promptly.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aw... ALRIGHTTTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Now we won't have to live in fear of an 
accident! Thank goodness... Thank 
goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Um, we'd like to do 
something to thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! The town's gonna be 
safer, and that makes me super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while afterwards, Katsuragi Ace and 
the others celebrated their shared joy 
with beaming smiles!
